segments.sn4.25:1.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato santike imā nibbejanīyā gāthāyo abhāsitvā tamhā ṭhānā apakkamma bhagavato avidūre pathaviyaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno kaṭṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhanto.
segments.sn4.25:1.2: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu –
segments.sn4.25:2.1: “Kenāsi dummano tāta, purisaṃ kaṃ nu socasi;
segments.sn4.25:4.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn4.25:4.3: Atha kho bhagavā na manasākāsi, yathā taṃ anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:5.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekamantaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ –
segments.sn4.25:5.3: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekasataṃ ekasataṃ kumārivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmā”ti.
segments.sn4.25:5.4: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekasataṃ ekasataṃ kumārivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn4.25:5.6: Tampi bhagavā na manasākāsi, yathā taṃ anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:6.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekamantaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ –
segments.sn4.25:6.3: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekasataṃ ekasataṃ avijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmā”ti.
segments.sn4.25:6.4: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekasataṃ ekasataṃ avijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn4.25:6.6: Tampi bhagavā na manasākāsi, yathā taṃ anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:7.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekasataṃ ekasataṃ sakiṃ vijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmāti.
segments.sn4.25:7.3: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … sakiṃ vijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
segments.sn4.25:7.6: Tampi bhagavā na manasākāsi, yathā taṃ anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:8.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekasataṃ ekasataṃ duvijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmāti.
segments.sn4.25:8.3: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … duvijātavaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā … pe … yathā taṃ anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:8.6: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … majjhimitthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmāti.
segments.sn4.25:8.8: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … majjhimitthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā … pe … anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:9.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … mahitthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmāti.
segments.sn4.25:9.3: Atha kho taṇhā ca … pe … mahitthivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā … pe … anuttare upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto.
segments.sn4.25:9.6: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekamantaṃ apakkamma etadavocuṃ – saccaṃ kira no pitā avoca –
segments.sn4.25:11.1: “Yañhi mayaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā avītarāgaṃ iminā upakkamena upakkameyyāma hadayaṃ vāssa phaleyya, uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ vā mukhato uggaccheyya, ummādaṃ vā pāpuṇeyya cittakkhepaṃ vā.
segments.sn4.25:11.2: Seyyathā vā pana naḷo harito luto ussussati visussati milāyati;
segments.sn4.25:12.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.sn4.25:12.2: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho taṇhā māradhītā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.25:14.3: Ekohaṃ [ekāhaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] jhāyaṃ sukhamanubodhiṃ,
segments.sn4.25:15.1: Atha kho arati [arati ca (ka.)] māradhītā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.25:16.3: Kathaṃ jhāyiṃ [kathaṃ jhāyaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.), kathajjhāyaṃ (ka.)] bahulaṃ kāmasaññā,
segments.sn4.25:17.4: Na kuppati na sarati na thino [na kuppatī nassaratī na thīno (sī.)].
segments.sn4.25:19.1: Atha kho ragā [ragāca (ka.)] māradhītā bhagavato santike gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.25:22.1: Atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
segments.sn4.25:22.2: Addasā kho māro pāpimā taṇhañca aratiñca ragañca māradhītaro dūratova āgacchantiyo.
segments.sn4.25:23.3: Giriṃ nakhena khanatha, ayo dantehi khādatha.
segments.sn4.25:24.1: “Selaṃva sirasūhacca [sirasi ūhacca (sī.), sirasi ohacca (syā. kaṃ.)], pātāle gādhamesatha;
segments.sn4.25:25.3: Tā tattha panudī satthā, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃva māluto”ti.
segments.sn4.25:26.3: Dhītaraṃ desitaṃ buddha, seṭṭhena imaṃ mārapañcakanti.

lines: Pañcame abhāsitvāti ettha a-kāro nipātamattaṃ, bhāsitvāti attho.
Upasaṅkamiṃsūti “gopālakadārakaṃ viya daṇḍakena bhūmiṃ lekhaṃ datvā ativiya dummano hutvā nisinno.
Āraññamiva kuñjaranti yathā araññato pesitagaṇikārahatthiniyo āraññakaṃ kuñjaraṃ itthikuttadassanena palobhetvā bandhitvā ānayanti, evaṃ ānayissāma.
“tumhe thokaṃ adhivāsetha, mayaṃ taṃ ānessāmā”ti pitaraṃ samassāsetvā upasaṅkamiṃsu.
Atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santinti, dvīhipi padehi arahattameva kathesi.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ senaṃ jinitvā ahaṃ eko jhāyanto “atthassa pattiṃ hadayassa santin”ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ arahattasukhaṃ anubujjhiṃ.
Tasmā janena mittasanthavaṃ na karomi, teneva ca me kāraṇena kenaci saddhiṃ sakkhī na sampajjatīti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – katamena jhānena bahulaṃ jhāyantaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ kāmasaññā alabhitvāva paribāhirā hontīti.
Na kuppatītiādīsu dosena na kuppati, rāgena na sarati, mohena na thīno.
Imesu tīsu mūlakilesesu gahitesu diyaḍḍhakilesasahassaṃ gahitameva hoti.
Paṭhamapadena vā byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ gahitaṃ, dutiyena kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, tatiyena thinaṃ ādiṃ katvā sesanīvaraṇāni.
Pañcoghaggahaṇena vā pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, chaṭṭhaggahaṇena pañcuddhambhāgiyāni veditabbāni.
Gaṇasaṅghacārīti gaṇe ca saṅghe ca caratīti satthā gaṇasaṅghacārī nāma.
Addhā carissantīti aññepi saddhā bahujanā ekaṃsena carissanti.
Acchejja nessatīti acchinditvā nayissati, maccurājassa hatthato acchinditvā nibbānapāraṃ nayissatīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Selaṃva sirasūhacca, pātāle gādhamesathāti mahantaṃ kūṭāgārappamāṇaṃ silaṃ sīse ṭhapetvā pātāle patiṭṭhagavesanaṃ viya.
Imasmiṃ ṭhāne saṅgītikārā “idamavocā”ti desanaṃ niṭṭhapetvā daddallamānāti gāthaṃ āhaṃsu.
Tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃva mālutoti yathā phalato bhaṭṭhaṃ simbalitūlaṃ vā poṭakitūlaṃ vā vāto panudati nīharati, evaṃ panudīti.
Ekasataṃ ekasatanti ekasataṃ ekasataṃ paccekaṃ sataṃ satanti attho.
Tā kira paṭhamaṃ kaññārūpena attānaṃ dassesuṃ.
Ettāvatā bālā taruṇī porīti tividhāsu itthīsu purimā dve dassitā, pariyosānavāresu manussajātikānaṃ manussitthiyova ruccantīti tena manussarūpena tā attānaṃ dassesuṃ.
Sā hi kilesasenā accharāsaṅghātasabhāvāpi paṭipatthayamānā piyāyitabbaicchitabbarūpabhāvato piyarūpasātarūpā nāma attano kiccavasena.
Eko ahaṃ jhāyantoti gaṇasaṅgaṇikāya kilesasaṅgaṇikāya ca abhāvato eko asahāyo ahaṃ lakkhaṇūpanijjhānena nijjhāyanto.
Idha dutiyapadassa attho vissajjanagāthāvaṇṇanāyameva āvi bhavissati.
Anāmantena “taṃ puggalan”ti sammukhā ṭhitampi bhagavantaṃ asammukhā viya katvā vadati, kathaṃ tvanti attho.
“Avitakkajhāyī”ti vakkhamānattā ayamevettha kāyapassaddhi veditabbāti āha “catutthajjhānena assāsapassāsakāyassa passaddhattā passaddhakāyo”ti.

Diyaḍḍhakilesasahassanti khuddakavatthuvibhaṅge (vibha.842,976) āgatesu aṭṭhasu kilesasatesu aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhāvicaritāni apanetvā sesā paññāsādhikaṃ sataṃ kilesā, te brahmajāle (dī. ni.1.31) āgatāhi dvāsaṭṭhiyā diṭṭhīhi saha pañcapaññāsādhikaṃ sattasataṃ hoti;
tā ca uppannānuppannabhāvena diguṇitā diyaḍḍhakilesasahassaṃ dasādhikaṃ hoti;
taṃ appakaṃ pana ūnamadhikaṃ vā gaṇanupagaṃ na hotīti “diyaḍḍhakilesasahassan”ti vuttaṃ.
Ayamettha saṅkhepo, vitthāro pana abhidhammaṭīkāyaṃ (dha. sa. anuṭī. nidānakathāvaṇṇanā) vuttanayena veditabbo.
Nīvaraṇappahānena khīṇāsavataṃ dasseti, anavasesato nīvaraṇānaṃ accantappahānaṃ adhippetaṃ.
Pañcadvārikakilesoghaṃ tiṇṇoti channaṃ dvārānaṃ vasena pavattanakilesoghaṃ taritvā ṭhito.
Kāmoghadiṭṭhoghabhavoghaṭṭhakilesabhāvato “pañcoghaggahaṇena vā pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni veditabbānī”ti āha.
Rūparāgādayo visesato na pañcadvārikāti vuttaṃ “chaṭṭhaggahaṇena pañcuddhambhāgiyāni veditabbānī”ti.
“Idamavocā”ti desanaṃ niṭṭhāpetvāti etena saṃyuttesu ayaṃ nigamanapāḷi, heṭṭhā anāgatanayattā pana kesuci potthakesu na likhīyatīti dasseti.
Nīharīti tāsaṃ kāyavacīvikāraṃ na manasikaronto tiṇāyapi amaññamānova anapekkheneva nīhari.
